source.author: verg
source.text: Haec ait, et socii cesserunt aequore iusso.
source.text_original: Haec ait, et socii cesserunt aequore iusso.
source.text_english: He said this, and his comrades gave way to the sea at his command.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: qua iussos sed tandem quaerere Colchos arte queat?
reuse.text_original: qua iussos sed tandem quaerere Colchos / arte queat?
reuse.text_english: By what means could he at last seek out the Colchians, since he was ordered?
